prompt:
Production animation sprite sheet for Unity, Swarmer. The one reference defines creature silhouette and camera; independently draw continuous poses matching that identity. Matte dark brown rocky armor, light gray-white tendon limbs, restrained amber eye, clean painterly pre-rendered 3D style, sharp legible silhouette at small game scale. Fixed elevated 45-degree camera and upper-left soft lighting. Very low, flat, small quadruped scout with one broad smooth wedge-shaped brown rocky carapace covering its back, small pointed front head with a narrow amber eye slit, pale gray tendon limbs splayed laterally, FOUR limbs only. No dorsal organs, no horns, no tall ridges. Keep the low turtle/beetle silhouette of the reference.
Facing for ALL frames: REAR THREE-QUARTER facing away toward upper-right, rear legs nearest viewer, nose toward upper-right. Never front-right. Do not rotate the camera or turn the body in later rows.
Strict grid: FOUR columns x 4 rows, exactly 16 full creatures. Canvas aspect width/height=4/4. Each equal square cell reserves at least 15% padding on every side around its creature. Consistent scale, center and foot baseline. NO touching/overlapping neighboring bodies, including wide collapsed corpses. Rows1-2: EIGHT distinct sequential WALK frames, alternating diagonal foot pairs lift and plant with a continuous scuttling gait, torso stays nearly level. Row3: FOUR distinct IDLE breathing poses, planted feet, subtle living tissues, no whole-body scaling. Row4: FOUR distinct DEATH poses: legs progressively buckle, carapace settles onto floor, head rests, eye goes dark; a quiet non-explosive collapse.
Distinct articulated leg steps, stable four-leg anatomy, single head, consistent plates. Do not simply duplicate or transform one still. Empty background fully transparent alpha0, including between legs. No shadow, floor, labels, text, diagram lines, grid, particles or projectiles.
